description: POST /v1/messages/count_tokens to an xAI upstream, which has no count endpoint: today's core counts locally and makes no upstream request.

headers.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Authorization, Content-Type, X-Api-Key, X-Goog-Api-Key, Anthropic-Version, Anthropic-Beta
headers.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS
headers.Access-Control-Expose-Headers: X-CPA-TRACE-ID, X-CPA-VERSION, X-CPA-COMMIT, X-CPA-BUILD-DATE, X-CPA-SUPPORT-PLUGIN, X-CPA-HOME-VERSION, X-CPA-HOME-BUILD-DATE, X-SERVER-VERSION, X-SERVER-BUILD-DATE, Location, Retry-After, ETag, X-Request-Id, OpenAI-Request-Id

exceptions.reason: The new core answers with its own estimate, a standard-library approximation of o200k_base. Today's core counts the translated Responses body with o200k_base, without the message role, so the number differs. With token_count_estimate off it answers an error saying the account cannot count (see anthropic-messages/codex/count-tokens-estimate-off).
